text:
Alex: Heads up — I'm drafting the compact release note for tomorrow's change window. Pasting a short version below; need ops + comms to OK, and @ops-oncall please confirm standby roster.

Alex: ```
Release v2.3.1 (internal first, then public)
- Fix: dispatcher hot path memory leak (reduces OOMs on high-concurrency)
- Perf: improved KV cache hit heuristics (~15% token cost reduction)
- Ops: added canary pin + automated fallback to v2.2.9 if latency spike >200ms
- Note: user-facing API unchanged; SDK patch-level bump only
```

Jamie: Nice. Two asks: add a single-line rollback criteria and a note about who owns the pin. Also include the exact pin command so we can automate the announcement.

Alex: Good call. Drafted additions: 
- Rollback: automatic rollback to v2.2.9 after 10m sustained p99 latency >200ms OR manual rollback via /deploy rollback v2.2.9
- Pin owner: @Jamie (will trigger internal-only pin, then flip to public after metrics stable)

Alex: Pin command we plan to run: `./deploy pin --version v2.3.1 --scope internal --owner @Jamie`

Liz: Quick note on coms — please avoid technical jargon in the public blurb. For internal, keep the kernel bits. Can we decouple pin from the blast? I want internal pinned first for 2 hours, then public blast.

Jamie: Yes — we can set a decoupled flow. Ops-runbook will: 
1) `./deploy pin --version v2.3.1 --scope internal`
2) wait 120m health check (automated)
3) `./deploy pin --version v2.3.1 --scope public`

ops-oncall: Standby roster for window: @ops-oncall (primary), @Sam (secondary), @Nina (observer). I'll be online at 02:00-05:00 UTC for the canary. Confirming I'll watch the latency dashboards and have rollback ready.

Alex: Perfect. Can we also add the exact rollback snippet in the internal note (short)?

Jamie: Added: `./deploy rollback --to v2.2.9 --reason "p99>200ms"` — keep it short.

deploy-bot: Deploybot scheduled: window=2026-03-24T02:00:00Z, estimated-duration=30m, change-id=ch_997001. Canary: enabled, auto-fallback=v2.2.9.

Liz: Thanks — that deploy-bot blurb is great. Last ask: who will post the internal announce? I'll take the public blast copy after internal thumbs-up.

Alex: I'll post internal announce and pin. @Jamie will run public flip after metrics look good.

Jamie: I'll be on-call for the flip. If anything looks off, I'll trigger the rollback command.

Liz: OK — comms action: internal note (detailed) goes at T-30m; public short blurb queued for T+2h. I'll prepare both snippets and attach to the PR.

Alex: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-notes/pull/421 — contains the exact text. Please comment by EOD.

ops-oncall: Acknowledged. Roster pinned.

Jamie: LGTM from me. :thumbsup:

Alex: Thanks everyone — locking this for prep. Will re-open if new comments.
